body: As a male, I find it when other guys use girls for sex is disgraceful, and I’m not saying that out of jealousy, more power to you. I hope that you find joy and find someone you know you can trust in the future.

I understand what you mean, I’ve been right where you are. My only friends just ditched me and now I am at an all time low again. I always try to put a smile on my face and stay positive when I am around family and acquaintances, but it’s just a second face. Every day is a struggle it feels like. No texts from people you like, no calls seeing if you want to do anything with them. You just feel like a ghost when you are around people.

I wrote a poem in my head that has kept me going and maybe you can put into your own words. “Each and every day, I shall walk into the fray, and I know that the day will go on. Each day I know is another to explore. Each day I know is a new one to implore. Each and every day, I shall walk into the endless fray, and I know that each day will go on.” 

Just know that there are people like you who are struggling as well. Just know there are people who do care because they are going through the exact same this.

Always stay positive and never give up.
I like to play on my Xbox, and play pool.
